Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In step 4, the WebSurfer's analysis incorrectly concluded that Icehouse was released in 1989 based on the visible text "Icehouse: The Martian Chess Set (1999)" on the BoardGameGeek page. The visible text explicitly shows the year 1999 next to the game title in the "Hotness" section of the page, indicating a 1999 release (likely a reprint or a specific edition tracked by BGG), not 1989. The agent hallucinated the year 1989 as the earliest release year for this specific entry, ignoring the explicit "1999" visible in the viewport. This led to the final conclusion that Icehouse (1989) was released before Kill Doctor Lucky (1996), whereas the actual earliest commercial release of the Icehouse system (The Martian Chess Set) by Looney Labs is widely cited as 1999, making the comparison with Kill Doctor Lucky (1996) incorrect (Kill Doctor Lucky would be first). The error stems from misinterpreting the visible date "1999" as "1989" or hallucinating the 1989 date despite the search results not confirming it in the viewport.
